heroSubhead: A unisex salon in Mumbai for colour, keratin, extensions, lashes, nails and skin — booked over WhatsApp, finished in the chair.
aboutCopy: HAIR5S is a unisex salon in Mumbai working across hair, skin and nails: colour and balayage, keratin, extensions and hair patch, carbon facials, microblading, lashes and nail art. One team, one standard of finish — for men and women in the same chair.
announcement: Appointments are confirmed on WhatsApp — no online payment needed.
